data.name: Exploding Wood Serpent
data.description: Summon an exploding wooden serpent
data.battleDescription: %user creates a wooden statue, the eyes of the statue starts to glow as a wooden serpent starts wrapping itself around %target then explodes

data.name: Guardian's Grove
data.description: Trap your enemy in a cave filled with poison.
data.battleDescription: %user traps %target in a wooden cave, inside the cave are poisonous plants that release toxic gas, debilitating %target

data.name: Forest Wisdom
data.description: Listen to your ancestors and learn from their previous battles.
data.battleDescription: %user stands still on the battlefield as a green aura surrounds them. They see memories of their ancestors' battles play out in front of them, blessing them with the wisdom of those long gone.

data.name: Wood Style: Wood Warrior Summon
data.description: Summon your ancestors’ sacred guardian.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra to summon a towering wooden warrior, a living construct to shield and fight.

data.name: Eternal Forest
data.description: Trap your enemy in a never ending Forest.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together and releases a massive amount of chakra, the earth starts to shake and crack open as massive tree limbs start shooting upward into the sky. Suddenly a branch springs forth dragging %target into the path of the onrushing roots.

data.name: Shinseina Ki
data.description:
In the heart of Fireheart Forest, where verdant foliage danced in harmony with the wind's whispers, resided a cadre of ancient spirits. Their ethereal essence infused the land with vitality and abundance, nurturing life within and beyond the forest's boundaries.

 

One fateful day, these benevolent spirits, curious about the lives of the humans dwelling at the forest's edge, donned human guise and ventured into the villages. Mingling among mortals, they forged bonds of friendship and empathy, enraptured by the joys and struggles of mortal existence. In a time when humans roamed as nomads, they stumbled upon this company and the splendor of the landscape, reasons ample enough to weave their dwellings into the fabric of this realm.

 

As time passed, the spirits grew deeply attached to their human companions, enchanted by their resilience and spirit. Some chose to relinquish their ethereal forms, embracing mortality to dwell permanently among the humans they had grown to love.

 

Through generations, the descendants of these spirit-human unions flourished, inheriting a potent legacy. Gifted with the ability to manipulate earth and wood, they became revered shinobi, guardians of the forest and its secrets. Their bloodline, infused with the ancient magic of the Fireheart Forest, endured as a testament to the enduring bond between spirits and mortals, shaping the destiny of the land for generations to come.

data.name: Lightning Release
data.description: Encase yourself in lightning natured chakra
data.battleDescription: %user generates lightning nature charka around their entire body

data.name: Wind Release
data.description: Calls forth a silent and swirling vortex to envelop and confuse.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the air, creating a silent cyclone that spirals onto the battlefield

data.name: Element Divine
data.description: Generate 5 cyclones of elemental chakra that collides against each other.
data.battleDescription: %user generates 5 cyclones of elemental chakra around %target. With precise control each cyclones converges on %target

data.name: Fire Release
data.description: A Flaming lotus that wraps it selfs around the target
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a flicker flaming lotus of With a whispered chant, the lotus blossoms mid-air — and from it burst dozens of petal-like fragments that streak toward %target

data.name: Water Release
data.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
data.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

data.name: Earth Release
data.description: Create a mauseleum of stone around yourself
data.battleDescription: %user entombs themselves in a rock formation protecting them from all sides

data.name: Shiroi Youso
data.description:
The archives of Seichi speak of a clan possessing the divine power to control and create elements. These shinobi, considered descendants of gods, can manipulate the natural world, shaping it to their will. With this volatile power, they can create and destroy at their whim, making them both revered and hunted.



Known as the Shiroi Youso, these bearers view the world as their own, molding it as they see fit. However, their immense power attracts those who seek to control it. The shinobi of this lineage constantly face threats from those who wish to harness their abilities for themselves, leading to a life of perpetual vigilance and conflict.



This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Lava Wave
data.description: Unleashes a tidal wave of lava.
data.battleDescription: %user molds their chakra with earth and fire, creating a towering wave of molten lava. With a swift motion, they release the wave, which cascades forward like a burning tsunami. %target faces the oncoming tide, but the overwhelming heat and pressure make escape nearly impossible. As the wave crashes, it incinerates everything in its wake, leaving behind a molten landscape.

data.name: Blow of Devastation
data.description: The user draws on their lineage to unleash a taxing surge of magma that leaves the opponent vulnerable.
data.battleDescription: %user draws deeply upon their bloodline, molten energy surging across their body as layers of living magma harden into blazing armor. With a decisive stomp, %user sends rivers of lava coiling around %target. The effort strains %user, while the intense heat disrupts %target’s defenses and leaves them vulnerable to further attacks.

data.name: Eruption Strike
data.description: Combines physical strikes with erupting lava bursts.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward with unmatched speed, their fists and feet glowing with molten heat. Each strike they deliver erupts in a burst of lava, searing %target's flesh and armor. The combination of raw physical power and scorching lava leaves a trail of destruction, overwhelming %target with relentless fiery assaults.

data.name: Magma Slayer
data.description: This jutsu enables the user to sacrifice some of their life force to summon an incredible, dangerous ally.
data.battleDescription: %user utilizes the power of their lineage along with some of their own life force to conjure from the molten depths a humanoid, magma form. As husk arises, an incredible heatwave is formed around the area. This husk emanates incredible temperatures and looks at %user's opponent with murderous intent and they prepare for the slaughter.

data.name: Infernal Stream
data.description: This jutsu combines the user's incredible physical strength with the explosive power of their bloodline.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of their bloodline and slams their fists on the ground and channels incredible power into the environment around them. After a brief respite, the battlefield around the opponent shakes as geysers erupt around. Suddenly, %user barrages the opponent with incredible speed and power. With every hit landed, a geyser erupts and showers the opponent with powerful blasts of magma.

data.name: Suragu
data.description:
A raw and powerful lineage passed down through the ages by the Suragu clan. The wielders of this bloodline have exact control over earth and fire to create lava, and its mastery will give them devastating power, making them capable of burning and melting anything and anyone in their path.


Legend has it that the origin of this bloodline is linked to the ancient lineage of the Ancient Phoenix, while others believe it to be a lost line of the Extinction Herald. Regardless, all agree that their ability and mastery, combined with their expertise in lava manipulation make them extremely formidable adversaries who should never be underestimated.

The extent of their power remains uncertain, only time will reveal what the future holds for this bloodline.

data.name: Solar Reverb
data.description: Focus the sun's radiance into a scorching blast that burns enemies and leaves searing light behind.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Amaterasu’s radiance into the battlefield beneath %target. Searing solar energy erupts on impact and continues to scorch the surrounding ground.

data.name: Incandescent Nova
data.description: Incandescent Nova showcases extreme control over the scorch release, summoning a radiant nova that converges on a target and evaporates a massive area in an instant.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a series of hand signs, unleashing a surge of chakra that forms a radiant nova around %target. The area rapidly evaporates as the nova converges inward, erupting in a devastating blast that inflicts lasting burns through simultaneous heat and dehydration.

data.name: Celestial Ignition
data.description: This technique enables the user to focus their innate bloodline mastery. As light gathers around them, their jutsu flows more easily, enhancing offense while making it harder for enemies to face such blinding brilliance.
data.battleDescription: %user fuses wind and fire chakra into a veil of pure light, enhancing jutsu control while dazzling %target with blinding radiance.

data.name: Radiant Embers
data.description: You release radiant embers that sap your target's strength while gathering into a protective solar shield around you.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures small solar orbs that dance around %target, weakening their attacks before forming a radiant shield around %user.

data.name: Stellar Inferno
data.description: Invoke a celestial inferno that engulfs the battlefield in scorching radiance. Blinding light and intense scorch chakra devastate the area, leaving lasting destruction.
data.battleDescription: %user calls upon the sun’s full power, evaporating the air around %target. As scorched oxygen enters their body, it dehydrates them from within, leaving them gasping and burning.

data.name: Taiyo Kami
data.description:
In the heart of the scorching Shining Dunes, a group of shinobi devotees of the sun sought solace amid the relentless heat.

Their prayers reached the ears of Amaterasu, who, moved by their resilience, bestowed upon them a divine blessing.

With a touch of Amaterasu's grace, the shinobi were divinely gifted, allowing them to harness their chakra and command the elements of fire and wind.

Through rigorous training and unwavering determination, they honed their skills, mastering the art of jutsu to wield flames and winds with unparalleled precision.

As the sun beat down upon the sands, the shinobi of Shine rose to prominence, their fiery spirits burning bright against the scorching desert.

With their newfound abilities, they became guardians of their land, using their jutsu to protect their people from threats both natural and supernatural.

Their legend spread far and wide, a testament to the strength and resilience of those blessed by Amaterasu's light.

And though the sands of time may shift and the winds of change may blow, the legacy of the shinobi of Shine will endure.

data.name: Cryostorm Aegis
data.description: Encases the user in a protective storm of ice and snow, slowing enemies.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels their chakra, the air around them begins to swirl with a sudden, fierce wind. In an instant, snow and ice materialize from the atmosphere, forming a spiraling vortex that envelops %user. The howling storm acts as a formidable shield, repelling attacks with its sheer intensity. Shards of ice dance within the tempest, deflecting projectiles and chilling any who dare approach. The very ground around %user becomes slick with frost, hampering the movement of the enemy and slowing their advance. The Cryostorm Aegis not only guards against harm but turns the battlefield into a frozen nightmare for the enemy, their every movement hindered by the biting cold and relentless winds.

data.name: Imperial Freeze
data.description: Imperial Freeze is an awe-inspiring jutsu belonging to the heirs of the cursed Teno Yuki lineage. This technique harnesses the elemental forces of water, wind, and ice to create an overwhelming and majestic frozen storm.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the essence of their bloodline, summoning the regal power of Imperial Freeze. With a series of precise hand signs, an immense blizzard erupts around %target, the air thick with shimmering ice crystals and freezing winds. The temperature plummets, and %target finds themselves ensnared in an exquisite yet deadly prison of ice. The biting cold gnaws at their strength, and the dazzling ice formations disorient their senses, making it difficult to tell friend from foe. The battlefield transforms into a majestic yet merciless winter landscape, showcasing the overwhelming authority of %user and the chilling grandeur of Imperial Freeze.

data.name: Ice Coffin
data.description: Trap your target in a coffin made of ice.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth an icy gust that washes over %target. Within an instant, %target finds themselves trapped within an ice coffin. %target Desperately tries to break the ice but each time they hit the surface of the coffin they only injury themselves as the snow covers them.

data.name: Frostbound Ascendancy
data.description: Empowers the user’s ice jutsu, creating a frost field.
data.battleDescription: Drawing on the ancient power of the Teno Yuki, %user summons a surge of freezing energy. Their body becomes a conduit for the icy might of their bloodline, as frost spreads from their feet, enveloping the battlefield.

data.name: Ice Palace
data.description: The sheer power of this jutsu serves as a testament to the user's profound connection with the icy elements
data.battleDescription: %user summons forth a great mist that obscure the vision of %target wrapped in this mist %target is taken into an icy palace, striken by the cold %target tries to escape but each step they take decreases their body temperature until they fall into a frozen coma

data.name: Teno Yuki
data.description:
A revered lineage that grants its wielders unparalleled mastery over illusions of devastating blizzards and cold storms. Born with an innate connection to the elements of water, wind, and ice, those with this bloodline possess a unique testament to elemental power with a force that unravels the boundaries between reality and illusion in the harshest of ways. Their artful manipulation of these elements transcends mere deception, offering a glimpse into the limitless potential that lies at the lines between illusion and the cold fusion of elements.

It is said that a couple, members of the Volcanic Tempest family, were expecting a child and, consumed by the idea of bestowing upon their future descendant an unparalleled power, ventured into the treacherous depths of Mount Meikan, seeking to forge forbidden pacts. However, fate had darker plans in store for them. Within the shadowed confines of the mountain, they encountered the ominous presence of Shikigami. With a chilling decree, he cast a curse upon them, foretelling that their firstborn would herald the dawn of a new bloodline—a lineage whose icy grip would spell doom for their kin.

data.name: Moonlit Inferno
data.description: Unleashes a fiery, electrified moonlight that damages, weakens, and exposes the enemy.
data.battleDescription: Beneath the silver glow of the moon, %user channels the fiery and electrifying power of Yin-Yang. A brilliant, searing light descends upon %target, infused with the destructive essence of both fire and lightning. The moonlit flames scorch deeply, while arcs of lightning crackle through the air, striking with deadly precision. The burning energy saps the strength of %target, dulling their ability to strike back and leaving them vulnerable to further devastation. As the moon’s radiant fury peaks, %user becomes a beacon of power, the night alight with the dual forces of fire and lightning, reshaping the battle with an overwhelming force.

data.name: Silent Rift
data.description: Silent Rift is a swift and elusive jutsu of the Tenohira Musei bloodline. It allows the user to instantaneously close the gap between themselves and their opponent, appearing next to them in a blur of Yin-Yang energy.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra, %user vanishes from sight, leaving behind a faint trail of shimmering energy. In the blink of an eye, %user reappears beside the opponent, the air crackling with residual Yin-Yang energy as they prepare to strike. The suddenness of the maneuver catches the opponent off-guard, allowing %user to take advantage of their proximity for a swift and decisive attack.

data.name: Yin-Yang Cascade
data.description: Yin-Yang Cascade is an advanced technique of the Tenohira Musei bloodline, unleashing a powerful wave of Yin-Yang energy that disrupts the chakra flow of all targets within its range, leaving them weakened and disoriented.
data.battleDescription: As %user unleashes Yin-Yang Cascade, a torrent of swirling energies erupts from their outstretched hands. The wave surges forward, engulfing %target in its path. As it crashes over %target, their chakra is disrupted, leaving them staggered and weakened, their movements slowed as they struggle to regain their balance amidst the chaotic energies.

data.name: Silent Palm Strike
data.description: Silent Palm Strike is a fundamental technique of the Tenohira Musei bloodline, utilizing Yin-Yang Release to disrupt an opponent's chakra flow upon contact with a precise strike of the palm.
data.battleDescription: With a focused gaze and steady breath, %user channels the power of Tenohira Musei, infusing their palm with Yin-Yang energy. %user swiftly closes the distance to %target, their hand poised to strike. As the palm makes contact, a surge of potent Yin-Yang energy erupts, sending a shockwave through %target’s body, immediately disrupting their chakra flow. In the aftermath, intricate symbols begin to flare across %target’s skin, forming a restrictive seal that targets and suppresses their bloodline abilities. This sealing effect weakens %target, cutting off access to their inherited powers and leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Eternal Stillness
data.description: Ensnares all in unending lunar stillness.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth the moon’s eternal stillness, casting a shadow of timeless peace across the battlefield. In this serene dominion, both %user and %target find themselves unable to alter their power or weaknesses. The world seems to hold its breath, as all movement of strength and vulnerability is frozen beneath the moon's unwavering glow.

data.name: Tenohira Musei
data.description:
In the heart of the Blackpeak Mountains, where the winds whispered tales of ancient rivalries, two clans stood in perpetual enmity. Their feud, born of ambitions to claim the coveted Plateau of Quietude, echoed through the valleys. Yet amid their strife, a peculiar bond existed between the leaders, masters of fire and lightning. Though driven by the primal urge to dominate, they harbored a grudging respect for each other's prowess.

 

One fateful night, a member of one clan sought to tip the delicate balance by ending the life of his rival. Igniting his chakra into a blazing inferno, he unleashed a fiery onslaught upon the unsuspecting leader. Witnessing this treachery, the leader's counterpart, instead of retaliating, rushed to shield his wounded foe. Moved by this act of selflessness, members from both clans rallied to his side, casting aside their animosity. Legend has it that even the moon deity, Tsukuyomi, shed a tear, blessing the moment with a celestial cascade of stardust.

 

From this union of formerly divided houses emerged the lineage of Tenohira Musei, inheritors of both fire and lightning. Their descendants, gifted with the ability to harmonize the two formidable elements, embody the equilibrium born from the crucible of conflict.
